title: Batches: Airflow observations, direct runs, automation and approval boundaries
goal: Distinguish bounded Airflow reads, reviewed direct DAG runs, configured automation, combined approval/execution and uncertain outcomes without claiming completed delivery or replay authority.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local preview; actual installed support, current flags/connection/role/session/provider outcome and native usability remain unverified.
Batches mounts Workflows, Automations, Approvals and Connection. Inspect returned state before a consequential action; opening a tab is not a DAG run or approval.
Use current authorized paired desktop identity and connected Airflow setup; inspected routes exclude API-key authentication. Never supply credentials or approval decisions through this article.
permissions: Reads require pipeline:read plus workspace:read. Connection writes require pipeline:trigger plus connections:manage. Rule creation/enabled changes require pipeline:trigger plus policy:manage. Direct DAG run requires pipeline:trigger plus deploy:execute; approve/reject requires pipeline:trigger plus agent:approve.

UI does not hide every action by role; server remains authoritative. Direct trigger rechecks current same session/membership/capability, persisted expiry/revocation, connection and mutation/Governance refusal before provider dispatch.

Human approval must be a genuine eligible human decision. Non-restart Approve & run is an existing combined approval/executor call; do not impose the Agent/Slack separate requester protocol or invent self/independence permissions. Restart approval additionally needs matching immutable review digest.

Existing outbound/Governance refusal and current source/dependency/destination checks remain mandatory. This workflow does not establish completed Governance enforcement, activation or full execution coverage.

steps.instruction: Use Connection status/Retry connection status; Open connection setup appears only for confirmed disconnection.
steps.expectedState: Loading/unavailable differs from disconnected; unavailable never removes existing connection or renders setup as proof of absence. Connected summary endpoint/version/DAG count is returned metadata, not ongoing health.

steps.instruction: In separately authorized setup, enter HTTPS deployment URL and username/password or bearer token, then Validate & connect; Disconnect revokes matching connection.
steps.expectedState: Client rejects credential-bearing/query/hash/unsupported URL paths, server validates independently. Successful setup clears password/token. Disconnect disables organization automations when connection exists, not already submitted Airflow work. Encryption/protection copy is not security certification.

steps.instruction: Choose a returned unpaused DAG; Run now opens the named DAG review. Cancel closes review or Confirm DAG run starts the explicit request after current selection/catalog checks.
steps.expectedState: Real tasks may affect external systems. Default empty configuration is sent; success says queued, not completed. Cancel before dispatch is local dismissal, not provider cancellation. No direct trigger auto-retry is promised.

steps.instruction: Use Refresh run history or Watch runs; Investigate with Agent carries selected DAG/run and current workspace context to Agent.
steps.expectedState: Default bounded catalog up to500DAGs, runs50, no mounted catalog/older-run pagination. Watch polls15seconds only in active ready visible workflow context. Investigate handoff is not execution authority or evidence the Agent received/acted.

steps.instruction: Inspect tasks on a run; Refresh tasks resets offset, Previous/Next move bounded pages.
steps.expectedState: Up to100 task instances/page, selected DAG/run identity checks, task state/try/map index observation only. No logs/XCom/templates/task retry/clear/cancel/deployment approval control. Error is not confirmed execution outcome.

steps.instruction: Create automation using name, source DAG, success/schedule trigger and Then action; verify listed repository/source branch/environment for write actions and dependencies under Advanced.
steps.expectedState: Schedules hourly/daily06:00UTC/Monday06:00UTC. Actions record completion/webhook notice, open PR or restart ECS service. Human approval locks on for GitHub/cloud. Payload fixes three configured predispatch retries/60second delay and notification flags, not scheduler/webhook liveness proof.

steps.instruction: Use Pause/Enable only on verified active rule records.
steps.expectedState: Updates enabled boolean, not schedule/action editing or cancellation of in-flight effects. No mounted delete button or existing-rule editor. Direct DELETE route is not a customer click path and refuses execution history.

steps.instruction: In Approvals personally inspect exact source DAG/run/state. For non-restart use Reject or Approve & run; for restart use Review restart destination then Approve service restart with matching immutable digest.
steps.expectedState: Non-restart approval invokes executor in same request. Restart review shows target/revision/role/region/ECS/repository/ref/dependencies and invalidates on context change; no review match means no approval. Service restart is not source release/image promotion, health verification or image recovery.

steps.instruction: Read status/attempt counts and Outcome unconfirmed — review before retrying. Use workspace/history refresh to observe original records.
steps.expectedState: Claimed attempt/provider dispatch intent blocks automatic replay after provider-start or uncertain reservation release; predispatch failures may use configured retry policy when allowed. Do not assume universal one-attempt automation, or treat retry configuration as permission to resend unknown provider action. No mounted replay/manual retry/cancel/full audit explorer.

steps.instruction: For errors follow bounded recovery guidance: correct inputs, refresh changed connection, inspect stale/missing review, or ask administrator about unavailable review storage.
steps.expectedState: Two current DAG routes now expose only established publicAirflowError codes or fixed fallback, not arbitrary internal/provider diagnostic prefixes. Unknown code/thrown failure still uses generic unconfirmed guidance; no successful recovery, provider absence or automatic rollback follows from error text.

expectedOutcome: Identify current observed state and exact authorized action boundary without confusing read/queued/approved/restart/unknown states with completed Airflow delivery, release promotion or permission for duplicate sends.
limitations: Customer eligible:false; publication approved:false; editorial/media/native/runtime/release/shipped acceptance:false. Null review and empty media; proposed IDs are authoring-only, not installed runtime help bindings.

Finite mounted Airflow/control/direct-handler inventory, not all Airflow, on-prem, Temporal/custom-engine support, scheduler liveness, webhook delivery, provider/cloud/GitHub installation, all transitive authorization paths or native/accessibility acceptance.

Current role/capability/flag/session/connection/credential/database/provider status was not read. UI labels, protection/encryption copy, returned readiness or HTTP acknowledgement do not certify security or completed application health.

Three configured automation retries are not permission to replay postdispatch unknown outcomes. Existing executor can retry eligible predispatch failure, while provider-start/release uncertainty retains reconciliation/hold. Do not replace unknown work with new requests solely to bypass the hold.
No Agent-style independent requester execution protocol is imposed on combined Approve & run. Human decision remains genuine and service-controlled; restart exact review digest remains mandatory.
Uncertainty notice/refresh/rejection/pause/Disconnect do not retract an external action or prove no side effect. Service restart does not promote a source artifact or establish image recovery.
Evaluation proposed-not-executed prose only; schema/source integrity is not retrieval/model/runtime validation, customer publication, media/editorial/release acceptance or complete B4/B5.
recovery: Refresh original workspace/run/task history after uncertainty; do not blindly replay a mutation or manufacture a human approval.
For unavailable connection status retry status first; confirmed disconnect alone offers setup. Setup/connect and provider credentials remain separately authorized operations.

For changed/missing/stale immutable restart review, reject/wait for a new proposal as guidance permits; unavailable storage leaves approval unavailable. Do not invent digest or treat prior target as current.
Pause or Disconnect affects future configuration/availability, not already dispatched provider work. Review actual saved/provider outcome through authorized workflows before deliberate retry.
Unknown/public fallback errors preserve uncertainty; they do not establish absence, completed rollback or healthy provider service.
